originalTitle: ICICI Bank eyes $500 million dollar bond issue via GIFT City
simplifiedContent: ICICI Bank is planning to borrow $500 million from investors by issuing bonds, which are like long-term loans. The bank will use the money it raises to lend to its clients, helping them with their financial needs. This is a significant move for ICICI Bank as it's their first time issuing US dollar bonds in about 10 years. The bank is able to do this through a special unit in GIFT City, which is a financial hub in India, and is taking advantage of a helpful facility offered by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). By raising this money, ICICI Bank will be able to support its clients and grow its business.

originalTitle: Anant Raj to demerge data centre arm into separately listed company
simplifiedContent: Anant Raj, a company, is planning to separate its data centre and cloud business into a new company called Ashok Cloud Pvt Ltd. This new company will be listed separately on the stock market. The goal of doing this is to increase the value for the company's shareholders and to help the data centre business grow. By separating the businesses, Anant Raj hopes to expand its data centre capacity to 307 MW by the year 2032 and improve its cloud services. This change aims to benefit the company and its shareholders by allowing the data centre business to operate independently.

originalTitle: Powerful rally! This Wall Street AI winner with 500% share price jump is not your typical chip stock
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: GE Vernova, a company, has seen its stock price increase by over 500% since it became independent in 2024. This is because investors think the company will do well due to the growing need for electricity to power data centers, which is leading to more orders and business for GE Vernova. The company is doing well in areas like power and gas turbines, which is helping its stock price rise. This is significant because GE Vernova is not a typical tech company, but its stock is still benefiting from the growing demand for artificial intelligence (AI) technology. The company's strong growth is making it an attractive investment opportunity.

originalTitle: IBM shares extend losing streak, plunge 26% in five sessions after sales miss
simplifiedContent: IBM's stock price has been going down for five days in a row, and it's now at a very low point. This happened because the company didn't sell as much as it thought it would, and it's also worried about its future sales. The stock price dropped by 26.5%, which is a very big decrease, and it's the largest drop in over 50 years. This matters because it shows that the company is struggling, especially with its software and infrastructure businesses, due to changes in what customers are buying and some supply shortages related to artificial intelligence. As a result, investors are losing confidence in the company, causing its stock price to fall.

originalTitle: Treasury Yields Hit Two-Month High as Oil Sparks Inflation Risk
simplifiedContent: The US Treasury market had a bad day, which means the interest rates on some government loans went up. This happened because oil prices rose, which can lead to higher inflation (when prices for things like food and housing go up). As a result, people think the Federal Reserve, which controls interest rates, might raise rates to combat inflation. This is important because higher interest rates can affect the overall economy and the stock market. The interest rates on these government loans haven't been this high in about two months.

originalTitle: Sebi tweaks SIF certification exam, removes currency derivatives questions
simplifiedContent: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has made some changes to a certification exam called SIF. They are removing questions about currency derivatives from the exam. Starting from September 21, the old exam will no longer be available and will be replaced with a new one called NISM-Series-V-D. This means that people who want to become certified to sell mutual funds will now take the new exam. This change matters because it affects how people become certified to work with specialized investment funds, which can impact the mutual fund industry.
